target_evidence: The sole translated target already states the full requested existential backward-error theorem relative to exactProductTree(t), with equality to roundedDotProduct(M,t) and the gamma(depth(t)+1,u) componentwise bound. The recursive constructions explicitly round each exact leaf product once and every internal addition once. No composition of supporting lemmas is needed to obtain the final statement. Existential product perturbations satisfy the source construction policy.

requirements.requirement: Prove the full universally quantified dot-product backward-error theorem.
requirements.evidence: The final target universally quantifies over every supplied model M and every tree t, and under (depth(t)+1)u<1 explicitly concludes existence of s with the required perturbation relation and exactSum(s)=roundedDotProduct(M,t). It covers arbitrary unbalanced trees and the single-leaf case.

requirements.requirement: Relate perturbations to exact componentwise products x_i*y_i.
requirements.evidence: The final target uses IsPerturbation(gamma(k,u),exactProductTree(t),s). The reference construction maps each original leaf (a,b) to its exact real product ab and preserves ordered nodes; the relation requires |q-ab|<=gamma(k,u)|ab| at every corresponding leaf.

requirements.requirement: Account for one rounded multiplication per leaf.
requirements.evidence: roundedProductTree replaces each leaf (a,b) with M.round(ab), and roundedDotProduct applies roundedSum to that very tree. The target includes the multiplication error in k=depth(t)+1; for a single leaf it asserts the gamma(1,u) bound for M.round(ab).

requirements.requirement: Account for every rounded tree addition in the reduction.
requirements.evidence: roundedSum returns the leaf value unchanged and at every internal node applies M.round to the sum of its recursively computed child results. The final target equates exactSum(s) to this constructed roundedDotProduct, accounting for all internal additions in the original grouping.

requirements.requirement: Establish the gamma(depth+1,u) componentwise perturbation bound.
requirements.evidence: The final target sets k=depth(t)+1 and gamma(k,u)=ku/(1-ku), assumes ku<1, and explicitly concludes IsPerturbation with this bound. Its leaf clause is |q-p|<=gamma(k,u)|p|, uniformly for all leaves including shallower ones. Depth counts root-to-leaf edges.

requirements.requirement: Use only the stated model and smallness assumptions without assuming or restricting the conclusion.
requirements.evidence: The translated model has u>=0 and, for every real z, an error delta with |delta|<=u and R(z)=z(1+delta). The only additional theorem hypothesis is (depth(t)+1)u<1.
